15.6-inch notebook PC, AMD Ryzen 7, 16GB RAM
What it is: A 15.6-inch laptop computer with an AMD Ryzen 7 processor and 16 gigabytes of RAM, made of various electronic components and plastics, which is a finished product used for general computing tasks.
reason: Laptops are considered data processing machines, which fall under either Chapter 84 (Machinery and mechanical appliances) or Chapter 85 (Electrical machinery and equipment).
